alt.zh: 灰色的月面延伸至画面右下方，蓝白色地球悬在黑暗中。
alt.en: A blue and white Earth hangs in black space above the grey lunar horizon.

note.zh: 1968 年，比尔·安德斯从阿波罗 8 号拍下《地出》。用作地月尺度的开场，不是中国航天任务照片。
note.en: Bill Anders took Earthrise from Apollo 8 in 1968. It sets the Earth–Moon scale; this is not a photograph from a Chinese mission.

opening.author: NASA / Bill Anders
opening.license: NASA Image and Media Usage Guidelines

edits.zh: 将原始胶片扫描旋转至月面在下，裁为 16:9，调整黑白点，转为 WebP。
edits.en: Film scan rotated to put the lunar horizon below Earth, cropped to 16:9, levels adjusted and converted to WebP.

title.zh: 嫦娥六号着陆点：来自月球轨道的目击
title.en: Chang’e 6 landing site from lunar orbit

alt.zh: 灰色月面上布满阴影长短不一的环形坑，中央分段圆环圈出着陆器的亮点。
alt.en: Craters and their shadows cover a grey lunar landscape. A broken ring marks the bright point of the lander in the centre.

note.zh: 2024 年 6 月 7 日，美国月球勘测轨道器 LRO 在月背阿波罗盆地拍到嫦娥六号着陆器；并非着陆器自拍。
note.en: NASA’s Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter imaged the Chang’e 6 lander in the Apollo basin on 7 June 2024. It is not an image taken by the lander.

moon.author: NASA / Goddard / Arizona State University
moon.license: NASA Image and Media Usage Guidelines
moon.originalTitle: NASA’s LRO Spots China’s Chang’e 6 Spacecraft on Lunar Far Side

edits.zh: 从原图中心裁为 16:9，轻调对比度，加分段圆环标示着陆器位置，转为 WebP。
edits.en: Centre-cropped to 16:9, slightly increased contrast, added a broken ring around the lander and converted to WebP.

title.zh: 北斗三号展品细节：星体与网状天线
title.en: BeiDou-3 model detail: spacecraft body and mesh antennas

alt.zh: 金色星体居中，上下两副网状天线的杆件清晰可见；紫色太阳翼向两侧伸出，翼端未入画。
alt.en: A gold spacecraft body sits between two mesh antennas. The purple solar wings extend beyond both edges of the frame.

note.zh: 2022 年香港创科博览展览现场的北斗三号卫星模型，不是在轨飞行器的照片。
note.en: A BeiDou-3 model exhibited at Hong Kong’s InnoTech Expo in 2022; not a photograph of an orbiting satellite.

edits.zh: 从 1920×1441 展览照片原生裁取 1280×720 局部。太阳翼端部及上方网状天线的一部分未入画，未放大或擦除内容；转为 WebP，本改编图沿用 CC BY-SA 4.0。
edits.en: A native 1280×720 detail crop from a 1920×1441 photograph; wing tips and part of the upper mesh antenna are outside the frame. No upscaling or retouching. Converted to WebP and shared under CC BY-SA 4.0.

title.en: Night lights over the Yellow Sea

alt.zh: 黄色的微弱大气辉光勾出弯曲的地球边缘，沿岸城市和海面灯光在云间发亮。
alt.en: Faint amber airglow traces Earth’s curved limb. City lights and lights on the water shine through gaps in the clouds.

note.zh: 2021 年 10 月 30 日摄于国际空间站。画面展示黄海周边的夜间灯光，不是天宫空间站拍摄。
note.en: Photographed from the International Space Station on 30 October 2021, this view shows night lights around the Yellow Sea. It was not taken from Tiangong.

closing.author: NASA / ISS Crew Earth Observations Facility, Johnson Space Center
closing.license: NASA Image and Media Usage Guidelines

edits.zh: 沿地球边缘与城市灯光裁为 16:9，缩小并转为 WebP。
edits.en: Cropped to 16:9 to retain the limb and city lights, downsampled and converted to WebP.
